plugin.name: AI Semantic Search
plugin.description: AI semantic search: reranks results by embedding similarity via the host embedding model
booster.name: Semantic Reranker
booster.description: Reranks engine-scored candidates by cosine similarity of embedding vectors
booster.weightDesc: Coefficient that converts semantic similarity into bonus score (default 50, roughly matching the standard matcher's base-score scale; no upper limit)
booster.modelIdDesc: An embedding model configured in the host (Settings → Models); switching models invalidates the cache since vector spaces differ
booster.listModelsDesc: Fetches the host's embedding model list to populate the dropdown above
